notes.title: GMS2 Update now live!
notes.notes:
Hello again! BPze here with a shocker! 

The GMS2 beta build that's been in the works since August has gone live for all players. Didn't intend on taking this long but real life had other plans. Better late than never, right?

Internally, there's been a *lot* of changes, including quite a few quality of life features that were long overdue. The two biggest new features though, are the introduction of a new game mode and a new ship! For the achievement hunters, there's two new achievements added to coincide with these new features.

Zen mode introduces a dynamic rank system designed with Arc mode's difficulty as the upper bound, ergo it should be easier for most players to appreciate the game and the quality-of-life adjustments that's been made. The HUD on the top-left corner has had a slight rework to accommodate a visual rank meter - it's not visually fancy but it gets the message across. 

In addition, the Bioweapon ship debuts as a throwback to the TLB of the classic "Zenodyne" Kaiser and I made in 2013. You'll need to get to the end of stage 6 in Zen mode *without* using continues to unlock this one.

Thanks to everyone who provided feedback, tried out the beta branch, reported bugs, and gave this game a go after so long! Should any issues arise, please report it in the feedback thread or community forum.

notes.title: GMS2 engine Beta now available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Banshee here with a surprise update from out of nowhere!

Zenohell now has an updated beta branch available to anyone interested enough to try it! I'd appreciate any feedback or help in finding bugs, regressions, and quality of life opportunities, so they can be addressed once and for all. Updates for the other games in our catalogue are planned but when time permits.

Making backups of your high score file is strongly advised if you want to keep your scores. You should be able to find the hiscore file at "[b]%LOCALAPPDATA%\Zenohell[/b]".

To access the beta, you need to find your way to the beta settings for the game. Here's how: 

[b]Step 1:[/b] open the steam app, open the Zenohell page, and click the settings icon. 
[b]Step 2:[/b] in the dropdown menu, click ‘Properties’.
[b]Step 3:[/b] click on the ‘betas’ tab and use the code “yesimadebackups”, which will reveal the beta version in the menu above.
[b]Step 4:[/b] if the download for the game doesn't start automatically, verify game integrity.

The obvious elephant in the room takes the form of two questions: [b]what's changed, and why now?[/b]

The big change is the engine migration to modern GameMaker, with some small changes for bullet and enemy visibility, and significant backend changes to reduce quirky behaviour with stuff like medals and shadows. The game should run better out of the box on modern computers, and hopefully be a bit less painful to look at.

It's been my grand master plan for some years now to update our games to fix long-standing technical issues and their respective codebases. With the team all focused on other things and having real life to deal with, unfortunately the time and energy just hasn't been there. 
In the years since 2015, the jury has spoken on the gameplay - Zenohell was the first, the oldest, and it shows. Fixing the gameplay is broader in scope and will probably take a whole new game/DLC, but I'm going to need a good foundation for that first.....

On that note, if you've read this far down and gotten the beta installed, hit keypad 1 in the main menu. Nothing huge, but I'm curious what people think of it.

notes.title: Big Update - Achievements!
notes.notes:
After fans steadily asked for those since the game launched, here they finally are! Steam Achievements! A whole 23 of them, will you be crazy enough to get them all?

On top of achievements, we've also fixed a couple of nasty bugs that were rare but STILL WERE BUGS, here's a short condensed list:

- Fixed the mysterious ship dissapearing bug
- TATE was fixed because it didn't work right under certain conditions
- Secret Ship #2's Firing Arc was fixed
- Fixed boss medals going offscreen vertically then suddenly coming on stage clear.
And many other little fixes that we won't bother you with ;)
